q: Which question type is GraphRAG best suited to?
options: Global questions such as “what are the main themes across these documents?”
explain: Community summaries answer questions no single chunk can.

q: What does CRAG add to basic RAG?
options: Grading retrieved documents and falling back to other sources when they are poor
explain: Corrective RAG checks evidence quality before generating.

q: What must agentic retrieval always have?
options: A budget on searches and tokens per question
explain: An agent unsure of its evidence will search forever without one.
